summary: Iteration 7 — verified the two small enhancements requested: (1) Sidebar Sign Out visible text label, (2) Kanban 3-dot per-card stage move menu. Backend: 19/19 pytest GREEN in /app/backend/tests/backend_test_v7.py — POST /api/leads/{id}/stage moves through all 7 stages (new/contacted/qualified/site_visit/negotiation/booked/lost), persistence verified via GET, invalid stage returns 422, unknown lead returns 404, stage_change activity is logged (with optional note text captured in message), executive Priya can move her own leads, /auth/logout works and subsequent /auth/me returns 401. Frontend Playwright: 6/6 flows PASS — (a) Sidebar renders visible 'Sign out' text next to LogOut icon (data-testid=auth-logout-btn) for admin, clicking it redirects to /login and cookies are cleared; (b) /leads?view=kanban shows 3-dot buttons on every card (54 cards visible for admin); clicking [data-testid=kanban-move-btn-{leadId}] opens a Radix dropdown listing all 7 stages, the card's current stage entry has data-disabled attribute set (aria-disabled='true' + data-disabled) and shows Check icon while the other 6 show ArrowRight; URL remains /leads (does NOT navigate to /leads/{id}); (c) Clicking [data-testid=kanban-move-{id}-to-negotiation] on a card currently in 'new' — the card disappears from the New column and appears in Negotiation without any page reload (new column count 19→18, negotiation 7→8), URL still /leads; backend PATCH via POST /leads/{id}/stage persisted and stage_change activity was recorded; (d) Clicking anywhere on the card BODY (name/phone area) navigates to /leads/{leadId} correctly; (e) Executive Priya login shows 18 leads all assigned to her; her 3-dot menu opens with 7 stage options; (f) List view (view=list) still renders with expected columns Lead/Contact/Source/Stage/Assignee/Budget/Age. No new bugs found. The stopPropagation on the 3-dot button and dropdown content works as expected — no accidental navigation.

minor.issue: The endpoint does not enforce executive-ownership on the stage move (any authenticated user can move any lead). Confirmed as existing behaviour per the review request (do NOT flag as new bug) — noting for documentation.

Pydantic model StageBody validation returns 422 for invalid enum values rather than 400. This is standard FastAPI behaviour and the frontend can't hit it (dropdown restricts choices), so it's only a concern for third-party API integrators.

issues: Recharts still logs 'width(-1) height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' warnings on initial render (carried from iterations 4/5/6) — cosmetic, doesn't affect functionality.

The 'Sign out' label uses text-[10px] uppercase tracking-[0.18em] which is quite small (10px). Text is legible against the dark forest sidebar bg but consider bumping to text-[11px] or slightly higher for aging users / accessibility. Not a blocker.

action_items: [Optional/Low] Consider adding server-side ownership enforcement on POST /leads/{id}/stage for executive role to prevent API-level moves of leads they don't own (currently only the GET/detail path enforces this). Explicitly out-of-scope per the review request, but flagging for a future security pass.
[Optional/Cosmetic] The Sign-out label in Sidebar is 10px — could be bumped to 11-12px for readability.
critical_code_review_comments: Leads.jsx KanbanBoard: the optimistic update in `move()` correctly sets state before the API call and does a `load()` on error to revert — clean pattern. However, if the API call takes >200ms the card visibly jumps twice (once optimistically, then again if server-returned data differs). Consider merging server response into state instead of a naive reload.

Leads.jsx line 187: `e.target.closest('[data-kanban-menu]')` guards the card onClick from firing when the 3-dot region is clicked. Works, but a cleaner approach is to have the 3-dot wrapper stopPropagation on its onClick (already done on the trigger button, but only there — the wrapper div itself doesn't). Belt-and-suspenders: current code is correct.

Leads.jsx uses `useNavigate()` inside KanbanBoard but the card container is a `<div>` — screen readers/assistive-tech will not recognize the whole card as a link. Consider making the card `role="button"` + tabIndex=0 + onKeyDown(Enter/Space) for keyboard accessibility.
Sidebar.jsx sign-out button uses `hover:bg-white/10` — good visual affordance. But there's no focus ring for keyboard users. Add `focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-white/40` for accessibility.

server.py POST /leads/{id}/stage: the `body.stage` value is written directly to the DB without checking it's a valid transition (e.g., lost → booked). Fine for a CRM but worth noting — could add a stage-transition FSM in a future iteration.

The kanban view fetches all leads and filters client-side by stage. For 500+ leads this could get slow; the API already supports ?stage= but not used in kanban mode. Not urgent for current dataset (~54 leads).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (6/6 flows: sign-out visible+working, 3-dot opens with 7 stages+disabled current, 3-dot move persists+optimistic UI, no accidental navigation, card body still navigates, exec scoping intact, list-view regression clean)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 7 suite lives at /app/backend/tests/backend_test_v7.py. Run: `python -m pytest backend/tests/backend_test_v7.py -v -o addopts=''` (the pytest.ini enables xdist by default; the -o override disables it so it runs in-process which is faster for this small suite). The 3-dot Kanban menu is now the canonical way to move cards; drag-and-drop still works but was not re-tested end-to-end this iteration (regression should be safe — the drag handlers on the card were untouched by the fix). Auto-EOD-modal was NOT triggered during this test (test times ran outside 18:00 local, so no dismissal needed; the script includes a dismiss guard anyway).
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — this iteration is a feature/enhancement verification, not a bug fix. Both enhancements ship correctly: Sign-out now has a visible label (was icon-only) and Kanban cards now have a 3-dot menu that moves the card via POST /leads/{id}/stage with correct activity logging, optimistic UI, and no navigation side-effects.
